description: Source code for media decoder implementation in the starboard android shared namespace, handling audio and video decoding, buffer management, error handling, and thread management.

classes.name: MediaDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for managing media decoding, buffer processing, error handling, and thread lifecycle for audio and video streams.

methods.name: MediaDecoder
methods.description: Constructor for initializing audio or video media decoder with relevant parameters.

methods.name: ~MediaDecoder
methods.description: Destructor that handles thread cleanup and media codec flushing.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with an error callback.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder, starting the decoding thread if necessary.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for video decoding.

methods.name: DecoderThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Static thread entry point for decoding thread.

methods.name: DecoderThreadFunc
methods.description: Main decoding loop handling buffer processing for audio or video.

methods.name: CollectPendingData_Locked
methods.description: Collects pending tasks and output results in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: ProcessOneInputBuffer
methods.description: Processes a single input buffer, handling secure decryption if needed.

methods.name: HandleError
methods.description: Handles errors from media codec operations, with retry logic for recoverable errors.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports errors to the client via callback, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecError
methods.description: Callback for handling media codec errors, logs and reports unrecoverable errors.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecInputBufferAvailable
methods.description: Callback when an input buffer becomes available.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecOutputBufferAvailable
methods.description: Callback when an output buffer is available, queues it for processing.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecOutputFormatChanged
methods.description: Callback when output format changes, queues a format change event.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecFrameRendered
methods.description: Callback when a frame has been rendered, invokes frame rendered callback.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Attempts to flush the decoder, cleaning up threads and resetting state.
